correctness.rationale: Normalized radial Fock eigenvalue Gamma moments verified; real weighted-L1 polynomial minimizer exists by finite-dimensional coercivity, satisfies exact signed orthogonality, has precisely N simple positive roots and is unique by common sign. The exact dual minimum and all-complex-symbol optimizer uniqueness follow by Holder equality and unitary averaging. Laguerre square kernel gives the lower bound, an explicit damped Laguerre symbol gives the upper bound, and an invertible smooth positive moment Gram matrix gives compactly supported exact approximants. Strict monotonicity follows from the nonvanishing next signed moment. 432 numerical and exact-algebraic checks pass; they do not replace proof.

value.rationale: Vacuum isolation on the first N homogeneous Fock levels is a mathematically canonical finite approximation to the impossible exact rank-one bounded-symbol Toeplitz projection. The result solves its sharp operator-symbol resource cost for every dimension/degree, supplies unique alternating concentric optimizers, establishes a nontrivial \(N^d\) obstruction, and proves smooth feasible approximants can approach but not attain the minimum. The exact invariant and rigidity are motivated by this operator problem, not by an arbitrary coefficient slice.
